name: golang-engineer
description: MAANG-principal-grade Go, enforced. Ships the golang-engineer skill (concurrency, leaks, errors, MDC logging, observability, data stores, security, resilience) with a 16-section PASS/FAIL rubric, a read-only reviewer subagent, a gated implement/review workflow, and blocking hooks that run gofmt, go vet, golangci-lint and go test -race so the standard cannot be skipped.
